positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Meta Superintelligence Lab - Building AI products

positions.title: MakerSpace Technician
positions.description:
• Oversee personal and class projects as well as help maintain the Makerspace.
• Host weekly trainings in 3D printing, Illustrator, and laser cutting.
• Design posters and other promotional material for official StudioLab events.

positions.title: Logistics Team Member
positions.description:
• Organize the world's largest student-run entrepreneurship competition by facilitating the logistics that include reaching out to VC judges, speakers, participants, and mentors.
• Establish relationships with VCs, alumni, corporations through transparent communication

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Developed and deployed a Vector Search Engine backed by Apache Solr 9 that integrated advanced dense search retrieval techniques into the existing customer service ticket search system for optimal semantic and relevant results.
• Embedded closed service tickets using the MirrorBERT model and transformed the data to be stored in a new Solr 9 collection.
• Improved search precision by 10% and increased discounted cumulative gain by 15% through replacing keyword-only searching with a real-time MirrorBERT InferenceService and dense vector retrieval through cosine similarity.

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented an order dimension model to more accurately track GMV and eliminate the need for intermediate tables using Seamster and Presto. Fixed revenue calculations by 10x to track total GMV instead of restricting by UTM parameter.
• Executed Pyspark segmentation analysis for partnering marketplaces regarding eligibility requirements for onboarding and promotion of Shopify shops on their platforms to measure YoY growth of eligible merchants and traction of marketplaces relations.
• Performed a full-reconciliation using Python and SQL on updated tables to ensure that existing logic was consistent.
• Built an onboarding dashboard dedicated to tracking key performance metrics with respect to merchants installing and onboarding to marketplaces apps using SQL and Mode Analytics.
• Segmented Shopify shops based on core Marketplaces features such as onboarding steps, rolling GMV, and Ad Spending and used these metrics to create SQL queries in preparation for partnering Marketplaces app migration & analytics.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · PySpark · Data Analysis · Machine Learning · SQL · Data Modeling

positions.title: Analyst (Communication Services/Information Technology Sector)
positions.description:
• Actively manage equity investments for ~$40k AUM private student-run fund with members across 5 top US universities.
• Apply a top-down approach and rigorous investment due diligence to analyze companies for short-term investment horizons.
• Perform in-depth company evaluations through discounted cash flow, comparable, and financial statement analysis.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
• Elementary, Middle, and High School Tutor
• Tutor in SAT, ACT, Math, English, Grammar, and Science

positions.title: Tech Intern
positions.description:
• Tasked with building e-commerce recommendation systems using collaborative filtering, content based filtering, and market basket analysis. Used Python and Neo4J to create and analyze the effectiveness of the different filtering methods.
• Created graph databases using Neo4J to represent product-to-consumer and product-to-product connections.
• Conducted Recency, Frequency, Monetary Valuations to assess customer spending trends and identify target audiences at each of the four main branches with intent to design individualized quarter goals and marketing plans.

positions.title: Pacific Northwest District Kiwanis Family Relations Committee Chair
positions.description:
• Lead the District committee to promote the Kiwanis-Family within Key Club
• Fostered an active, collaborative relationship on all levels between the branches of the Kiwanis-family in the Pacific Northwest
• Represented the district at Kiwanis events
• Planned and organized the creation of promotional and educational material for clubs in our district with 13,000+ members to utilize

positions.title: Lieutenant Governor
positions.description:
• Planned, organized, and lead all division-wide events and functions
• Elected to serve as the liaison between the Pacific Northwest District and 10 local clubs
• Trained officers (50+ club officers)
• Represented the division at Kiwanis and District events
• Raised money for The Thirst Project to build water wells in Swaziland
• Published monthly newsletters to highlight past events, spotlight members, and promote upcoming activities

positions.title: Club Founder & President
positions.description:
• Founded the Key Club at Mountainside High School
• Planned meetings, service opportunities, social events, and other club functions
• Lead officer meetings and delegated tasks to each officer
• Organized monthly club evaluations and successfully increased membership by 500% in two years
• Worked with local non-profit organizations to give back to our community (Red Cross, THPRD, Play Fit Fun, The Oregon Food Bank, The Salvation Army)

positions.title: Market Research Intern
positions.description:
• Created reports of competitors with analysis of their prices, sales, and method of marketing for the Software-Defined Infrastructure Ecosystem to improve Intel’s Rack Scale Design
• Mastered the Scrum framework to effectively collaborate on a team and plan out projects to solve complex problems

positions.title: Entrepreneur
positions.description:
• Started a company that provides coffee candles made from recycled coffee grounds
• Presented to local investors and received funding of $1,312.00 to start the business at local markets and an online platform
